message: No detected input validation: The code only restricts file upload type to csv/xlsx via Streamlit's `type` parameter but performs no schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on the uploaded data content.

No detected untrusted source handling: Data is acquired via a user file upload with no remote source fetching, and no integrity verification (checksums, signatures, or authentication) is performed on the uploaded file.
No detected label flipping detection: There is no code that validates label values against an expected set, checks label distributions, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The preparation functions only handle NaN filling, encoding, scaling, and oversampling; there are no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or suspicious-input filtering steps.

No detected model integrity verification: The code trains models from scratch using sklearn and does not load any pretrained weights or serialized models, so no integrity verification (hash check, signature, pinned revision) is present.

No detected label distribution validation: There is no code that checks class balance, validates the expected label set, or detects anomalous training samples before training begins; oversampling is applied but without any prior distribution check.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: No backdoor or trigger detection mechanisms (e.g., neural cleanse, activation analysis, gradient anomaly detection) are present anywhere in the code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or mechanisms are imported or used in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries or techniques (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) are imported or used anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: Although train_test_split is used to separate data, there is no isolation enforcement, hashing/signing of evaluation data, or use of multiple independent metrics to guard against metric manipulation; the scaler is fit on training data but no formal held-out test set protection mechanism exists.
No detected input sanitization: The code reads uploaded CSV/XLSX files and processes them without validating input shapes, value ranges, or schema correctness before passing data to models.
No detected output bounds checks: There are no checks on model outputs for NaN values, probability bounds, or calibrated thresholds before returning results to the user.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This pipeline uses classical ML models (not LLMs), so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
